acceptanceCriteria: The TCP-V0-037 failure mode states that rows admitted by a non-lexical slot are never blamed and carry no ownership entry, and that this absence is not evidence of agreement; `coverage.recency.ownership` and the row reasons agree by test.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #95 (V1-0089): after the review fix, `blameHead` blames only `unchosen(rows)` (recency.go:174, helper :192), so rows admitted by other slots get no ownership check at all. The spec sentence 'absence of an ownership entry is not evidence of agreement (invariant 2)' is written only for the oversize or unreadable CODEOWNERS case and should also cover rows that were never blamed.
